status: completed experimental follow-up; not production validation
recommendation: Pursue cached member-certified object checkpoints plus native v3 causal field openings as the next production-design candidate. Retain reconstruction as a research comparison; explicit stale-view bridge replay is not competitive in the measured long-offline case.
oracle: Real AdmissionMonitor, actual R5/R6/R7 profile, Ed25519 complete semantic-envelope signatures and native v3 root signatures emitted at edit creation.
policy: Fixed roster of four and at most one Byzantine member for cached three-distinct-endorsement certificate. All-member reconstruction uses cached signed cuts, including the offline member. No votes/signing keys are needed to construct field openings or verify them during opening.
demonstrated: Real drawing ValuesPerKey projection matches full accepted-history folding after offline/concurrent edits.
Unknown dependencies stay Unknown; authentic out-of-range repeat steps remain violations.
Covered identity proofs authorize prior accepted metadata only when rooted in accepted checkpoint trust; native field openings bind header values to content roots.
Duplicate delivery does not refold old writes; supplied authenticated bodies and root signatures remain available for equivocation evidence.
Anchor order does not discard bridge evidence; layered verification avoids per-edit cloning of retained history.
Both paths preserve existing core choice verdicts; an unindexed obligation conflict produces a verifiable native equivocation proof.
limits: This is not Acumen proper: explicit bridge replay and signed compact member views; no history-prefix consistency construction or secure second-order garbage collection.
Experimental tail adapter is not integrated into production AdmissionMonitor and does not modify production APIs.
Only fixed-membership, bounded-repeat, single-predecessor drawing profile is covered; indexed all-occupant fan-in may require full payloads under existing completion semantics.
Prior accepted-set truth and snapshot correctness rely on the specified member endorsement assumptions; a Merkle opening alone does not establish correct folding.
No membership changes, freshness/completeness against unseen updates, durable signer recovery or resource-counter rules are implemented.
Provider retains accepted identity index and historical metadata/bodies. Ongoing client signed evidence is retained; no unconditional constant-space claim.
Benchmark is logical empty-client bootstrap, local JSON medians of three samples, not network/browser latency or production throughput.
Pinned root/dialect/roster are common context excluded from packet totals; bootstrap verifies root in both paths.
Package generation, certification and provider index maintenance costs are excluded from open timings.
Existing repeated-name equivocation detector limitation is recorded, not changed by this experiment.
